title: HINT for Auditors — findings stay evidence-based
metaDescription: Keep engagement scope, procedures, evidence, findings and severity together so assistants do not turn assumptions into audit conclusions.
h1: Your assistant drafts findings fast. HINT keeps conclusions inside the evidence.
intro: HINT keeps engagement scope, criteria, procedures and evidence in plain-text notes beside working papers. Your assistant reads only what applies to this engagement before drafting a finding.

situations.before: A draft finding extrapolates beyond the tested sample.
situations.body: Sample facts and procedure results stay visible, so unsupported population-wide language is removed or qualified.

situations.before: Severity is chosen because the wording sounds serious.
situations.body: Impact and likelihood must map to the engagement's approved rating criteria.

situations.before: A useful observation drifts outside engagement scope.
situations.body: The assistant separates an out-of-scope issue for follow-up instead of presenting it as an audited conclusion.

example.intro: The Wonka audit demo grounds its factory-access finding in the engagement's approved evidence.
example.after: It drafts from SRC-1, keeps the finding inside the engagement boundary, and will not infer sample results that were never observed.
example.compiled:
<finding name="factory-access-2026-1">
  Approved finding grounded in SRC-1.
</finding>
<never name="Invented details">…</never>

never: Invent sample results, evidence or an unsupported finding.
Assign severity outside the engagement's declared scale.
Present out-of-scope work as an audited conclusion.
disclaimer: HINT assists with audit documentation; it does not provide assurance, replace professional skepticism or sign an audit opinion.

faq.a: No. It carries scope, procedures and evidence context into drafting; auditors perform and evaluate the work.
Only by applying the declared scale to documented impact and likelihood; missing inputs remain unresolved.
Folder scope keeps engagement-specific evidence out of unrelated working papers.

keywordDescriptions.engagement: Sets the subject, period, team and scope of the audit.
keywordDescriptions.objective: States what the engagement is intended to determine.
keywordDescriptions.criteria: Names the standard used to evaluate evidence.
keywordDescriptions.audittest: Defines a procedure and the population or sample it covers.
keywordDescriptions.evidence: Records an observed artifact and its provenance.
keywordDescriptions.finding: Connects criteria, condition, cause, effect and evidence.
keywordDescriptions.severity: Applies the engagement's approved rating scale.
keywordDescriptions.followup: Records remediation ownership and the next review point.
